name: nexa v0.0.31 Alpha — nexaween: Interface Polish & Release Integrity
body:
# nexa v0.0.31 Alpha — nexaween: Interface Polish & Release Integrity

**nexaween Alpha prerelease · Windows x64 · portable**

This release focuses on interface polish, dependable update discovery and a more natural seasonal ecosystem. It includes the .30 refinements and preserves existing Spaces, notes, tasks, recordings, history, preferences and account connections.

## Interface polish

- Consistent lowercase **nexa** branding throughout visible app labels and release notes.
- Independently centered Recent Space names with larger icons, improved Home header alignment and the approved pumpkin artwork with Home-only candle flicker.
- Edit a Space icon in Session Settings using a preview, selected highlight, Save and Cancel; includes a cap-and-gown choice.
- Readable, wrapped Pixel Timer status and Test Sound directly beneath Sound Style, using the selected style and volume.
- Retained fullscreen notification spacing, Space-name/icon ordering, wallpaper controls and session/history safeguards from earlier refinements.

## Updates and release integrity

- Shared canonical version handling: **0.0.X Alpha**, future **0.1.X Beta**, and **1.X stable**. Confirmed historical Alpha versions are recognized without confusing them with Beta.
- Newest eligible release selection across paginated feeds, saved channel preference and clearer network, rate-limit and incomplete-package errors.
- Permanent Updates page with installed/latest versions and optional startup checks.
- Verified download checks, backup, separate update helper, restart health checks and rollback remain in place.

**Upgrading from .24/.26:** those old executables use a numeric comparator that can reject canonical `0.0.X` releases as older. Save your work, close nexa, keep the old executable as a backup and manually replace only `Nexa.exe` with this release once. Keep the existing LocalAppData `SessionDashboard` data folder. The corrected updater handles later eligible releases; GitHub metadata changes cannot repair code inside an old installed executable.

## Seasonal ecosystem

- Rounded spiders with eight front-body leg roots and slower turning.
- Orb webs grow strand by strand as the spider travels, with cached curved silk and construction stopping if the builder is missing.
- Explicit session loads start fresh live creature/web/candy activity. Permanent totals, preferences, pending awards and ordinary restart/crash recovery are preserved.

## Download and validation

Download **Nexa.exe** and **SHA256SUMS.txt** from Assets. This is a self-contained Windows x64 executable; no installer or separate .NET runtime is required. Compare `Get-FileHash .\Nexa.exe -Algorithm SHA256` with the supplied checksum. The executable is not code-signed.

- **21 regression routes / 883 assertions passed**, plus **17 native packaged-update checks** covering genuine upgrade, data preservation, restart and rollback.
- Release build: **zero warnings, zero errors**.
- Executable source: `938f5185f6a752ab6a8ee68bfdf5d97256d4f267`. Release tag also includes documentation/evidence updates; application source is unchanged.
- Executable SHA-256: `a4af062cfba9ab946568e6f823b0bc8cf06ff68ceb9a95e9b2cc909ca60681f8`.
- [Publication evidence](https://github.com/scrmarsh/nexa/blob/v0.0.31-alpha/docs/NEXA_031_PUBLICATION.md).

## Remaining Alpha limitations

Google/Microsoft account, calendar and task integration expansion was deferred by user request. Existing connections remain available. Physical mixed-DPI/multi-monitor/focus behavior, second-computer updating, live-provider authorization, listening tests and sustained CPU/GPU/memory acceptance remain open. The reported physical maximize-only pumpkin disappearance did not reproduce in the isolated current-source fixture; it is not claimed as physically certified.

name: nexa v0.0.26 alpha — Spaces in Motion
body:
# nexa v0.0.26 alpha — Spaces in Motion

**a space for whatever comes next**

A more useful Space from first setup to the end of a session, with cumulative productivity, interactive guidance and refined optional Nexaween artwork.

## Download

Download **Nexa.exe** from Assets and run it on Windows x64. This is a self-contained portable .NET 10/WPF build. Keep your existing saved data; do not remove the Windows LocalAppData SessionDashboard folder.

This alpha executable is not code-signed. SHA256SUMS.txt identifies the exact download; inspect it with Get-FileHash ./Nexa.exe -Algorithm SHA256.

## Productivity and session completion

- Persistent cumulative productivity totals per Space, with session starting/ending score snapshots and recorded-event deduplication.
- Click collectible candy for one base point and a shared streak increase of 0.5x, subject to the existing cap and rate protection.
- Circular Productivity widget with animated score/progress and a brief pulse.
- Dedicated End Session action saves before finalization, prevents duplicate completion and provides approximately one second of visual Pixel Timer completion when ending early.
- Animated recap with recorded accomplishments, score comparison and return-to-Dashboard/Home actions. Actual elapsed time stays distinct from the completion animation.
- Automatic safe saving and recovery retain existing layouts, settings and records.

## Getting comfortable

- Interactive Quick Start spotlights teach adding, moving, resizing and renaming real widgets, with skip, replay and restart recovery.
- Refined setup cards, optional integration introductions, independent appearance/sound controls and separate manual/schedule Pixel Timer drafts.
- Six initial recent-Space cards, expandable older Spaces, saved Space icons, lazy Settings pages and safer navigation preparation.

## Optional Nexaween details

- A larger Home corner web and slowly moving web-bound spider.
- One naturally rounded pumpkin body with carved candlelit features and internal rib shading.
- Earthy green vines connected to the stalk, including long window-edge branches, curls and leaves.
- Pumpkins attached to available widget corners, preserving world coordinates through scrolling and resizing.
- Theme/border/logo transitions respect reduced-motion preferences. Seasonal artwork remains noninteractive around normal controls.

![Fullscreen Home, sample Spaces](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/scrmarsh/nexa/e63ea704090b7299c2e07662a9411601a9ba66c4/docs/media/preview026/home-fullscreen.jpg)

## Verified

- Release application/test build: **0 warnings, 0 errors**.
- **507 regression checks** across all fifteen routes, including layout/scrolling, scheduling, persistence, scoring, guide and animation.
- **10 native updater checks** against this exact executable: rollback, data preservation, duplicate protection, interruption recovery, tamper rejection, separate helper installation and isolated restart.
- Packaged x64 startup: PerMonitorV2, 759 square pixels, four presets and all three bundled Bible datasets.

Executable source: e63ea704090b7299c2e07662a9411601a9ba66c4. The release tag also includes documentation and main-branch documentation reconciliation; application source is unchanged from the verified build.

**Nexa.exe SHA-256**
1D08B896653932F0470BF09EEF5464887BC9ABB0C539E8E91AC549B227E0868C

## Known alpha limitations

- Physical mixed-DPI/multi-monitor interaction and all visual transitions are not fully certified.
- Genuine Windows hibernate/crash recovery and migration of an approved private saved-data fixture still need manual testing.
- Live Todoist, Hevy and Hedy accounts, and updating a real installed older release, were not exercised. Updater validation used isolated synthetic data.
- Extended-session memory and live high-density rendering FPS remain unverified.
- Navigation profiling showed a remaining Space-load latency outlier. These results do not establish universal performance improvements.

No previous GitHub release assets are replaced by this release.


### Canonical Alpha identity and download compatibility

This release is **nexa v0.0.26 alpha**. The historical tag `v0.1.26-alpha` is retained so existing download links continue to work. Canonical Git tag `v0.0.26-alpha` points to the same original commit. Assets, SHA-256 checksums and original publication time are unchanged. Older numeric-only updaters need the documented one-time verified portable upgrade; this metadata correction cannot patch an already-installed comparator.

name: nexa v0.0.29 Alpha — NEXAWEEN: Interface Polish
body:
# NEXAWEEN: Interface Polish — v0.0.29 Alpha

**Nexaween prerelease · Windows x64 · Alpha**

This Nexaween update focuses on polishing the interface: clearer text, more consistent branding, better fullscreen spacing and more useful widget layouts. It remains an Alpha prerelease; v0.1.0 is reserved for the first approved Beta.

## Interface polish highlights

- **Cleaner typography and Space labels.** Larger, more readable Home titles; icons appear before names on Home and after Space names in the dashboard top bar, with theme-aware contrast.
- **A more cohesive fullscreen workspace.** Compact navigation at the top edge, a temporary overlay hint, optional Windows battery/network/volume controls, and matching 12-DIP side/bottom padding for notifications, tips and the productivity banner.
- **Refined Nexaween branding.** Lowercase version labels below the logo, a complete five-second splash, compact previews and seasonal in-app artwork. The Windows executable keeps the Classic nexa icon.
- **Independent wallpapers.** Home and individual Spaces have separate previews, fit/fill controls and restore-default actions. Space wallpaper lives in Session Settings.
- **More readable widgets.** Growing Hedy/timeline text regions, expandable interval cards based on actual saved content, a compact recording-source selector, live productivity breakdowns and playful distraction messages.
- **Consolidated Session Settings.** Manual/Scheduled timer configuration appears directly in the existing Session Settings interface.

## Supporting reliability improvements

- Manual End Session saves the original History snapshot before resetting session values, presents coordinated closing visuals and reuses the existing recap.
- History offers explicit Resume Previous Session and Load as New Session choices, preserving the source record and preventing repeated score credit or automatic recording.
- Tasks, layouts, Space preferences, all-time statistics, recordings and account connections are retained. Scheduled review/postponement behavior remains available.

## Download and run

Download **Nexa.exe** from this release. It is a self-contained portable Windows x64 build; a separate .NET installation is not required. The executable uses the existing Windows LocalAppData save location.

`SHA256SUMS.txt` records the executable's checksum. To compare it locally:

```powershell
Get-FileHash .\Nexa.exe -Algorithm SHA256
```

## Validation and prerelease status

Release application/checks build and self-contained publish are verified before publication. The complete regression gate covers **19 routes / 786 assertions**. Packaged startup uses a disposable workspace and checks native WPF initialization and embedded Bible resources.

Physical multi-monitor/mixed-DPI/focus behavior, charging/device transitions, live Hedy/Hevy/Todoist authentication and extended-session performance remain open acceptance items. Local-audio transcription and semantic interval summaries require an available connected capability; nexa does not invent summaries when source content or that capability is unavailable.

This is explicitly a **Nexaween Alpha prerelease focused on interface polish**, not a Beta or stable release.


Source commit: `496dea2db01d4d59832febe5780dacebadd1e88f`.
Executable SHA-256: `badbdb24fc0345cc6ed00c27cc873bb92068f27194ca23f25452cba0f57cd9cd`.

name: nexa v0.0.24 alpha — NEXAWEEN
body:
![NEXAWEEN — nexa v0.0.24 alpha](https://github.com/scrmarsh/nexa/raw/refs/heads/main/docs/media/nexaween-banner.svg)

**A space for whatever haunts you next.**

nexa 0.0.24 Alpha brings the essentials together: recurring sessions, reliable saving, readable history and a dashboard with room to grow. NEXAWEEN adds a little candy, a little crawling and plenty of personality.

## Download and run

Download **Nexa.exe** under **Assets**, place it in a folder you control, and run it on **Windows x64**. This self-contained executable includes .NET 10; no installer or separate runtime is required. Existing Spaces, presets, notes, history and settings remain in the established LocalAppData location.

`SHA256SUMS.txt` contains the executable's SHA-256 checksum. Compare it with `Get-FileHash .\Nexa.exe -Algorithm SHA256`. This Alpha executable is not code-signed.

## The Archives Awaken

- State reads wait for an in-flight checkpoint, preventing transient file replacement from loading empty defaults.
- Searchable session history, continuous/event-driven saving and configurable autosave intervals.
- Recovery records and save-before-reset safeguards preserve work and review time.
- One Session entry brings together saving, history and tips; the Timeline retains its Hedy and recording purpose.

## Time Is Under a Spell

- The Pixel Timer fills from the top-left during class and clears in reverse while counting down to the next session.
- Recurring weekdays, date/duration editing, selected time zones and three-decimal progress precision.
- Linked progress bars share authoritative timestamps; independent bars retain their own ranges.

## The Dashboard Has Been Haunted

- Nexaween branding, the seasonal changelog palette and candy-only backgrounds.
- Pumpkins and vines use actual widget targets, remain aligned during layout changes and stay clear of controls.
- Classic, Cozy, Creepy and Combative modes, six seasonal costumes and species-specific movement.
- Persistent spider-owned webs remain separate from seasonal decoration placement.
- Productivity Meter, score breakdowns and bounded two-minute squash streaks.

## A tidier home for nexa

Retired story code, old pre-naming-scheme material and mixed development logs are preserved in `LEGACY`, excluded from the current build. Source, development instructions and current release notes have clear homes; generated builds and personal data stay out of Git.

## Verification and remaining checks

The release is built as a self-contained Windows x64 single-file application and receives an isolated packaged-startup check, including embedded offline resources. The ten-route automated suite covers core functionality, reliability, timing, scrolling/layout, menus, the ecosystem and animations.

Physical sleep/hibernation, live provider/microphone integrations and extended mixed-DPI/GPU sessions still need manual acceptance. Procedural creature movement is stylized; detailed cooperative choreography remains future polish.

[Implementation and verification report](https://github.com/scrmarsh/nexa/blob/main/docs/IMPLEMENTATION-0.1.24.md) · [Root audit](https://github.com/scrmarsh/nexa/blob/main/docs/ROOT-AUDIT.md)

Source commit: `4562d696f39e181e180d1b3b93fc4d060b941dce`

Automated regression: **335 checks passed** across ten routes; Release build: **0 warnings, 0 errors**.
